page.title: King Legacy Codes for Roblox: Facts, Tips & FAQ
page.meta_description: Looking for codes for King Legacy on Roblox? See what the official page says, plus gameplay facts, tips, and answers about fruits, level cap, and more.
page.tagline: King Legacy is a Roblox adventure with fruit spawns, a high level cap, and a community server that the official page points to for codes.
overview: King Legacy is a Roblox adventure game from Sea King Games. Its official Roblox page lists a level cap of 5450 and 45 Physical Fruits in-game. Fruits spawn on the map every 1–2 hours and despawn after 15 minutes, and first-time players have a 0.1% chance to get a free Conqueror Ability.

If you are searching for codes for King Legacy Roblox, the official description points players to the community server for more information and codes. It does not include a list of active codes in the description, so the community server is the source to check.

The game supports up to 12 players per server and is listed on Roblox for PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation, and VR. The Roblox page was created on 2019-12-17 and lists Adventure as its genre.

how_to_play: Open the official King Legacy page on Roblox.
Launch the game on one of the supported Roblox platforms.
Join the community server linked in the Roblox description for code information and updates.
On your first join, note the 0.1% chance at a free Conqueror Ability.
Watch for fruit spawns every 1–2 hours; fruits despawn after 15 minutes.
tips: Use the official community server for code information rather than an unverified code list.
Fruit spawns are on a 1–2 hour timer; grab a fruit before its 15-minute despawn.
The first-join Conqueror Ability chance is only 0.1%, so treat it as a bonus rather than a plan.
The level cap is 5450, so treat progression as long-term.
There are 45 Physical Fruits to find, so keep track of what you encounter.
